featured_reviews.review_text: We hired Hashim Caterers for our family wedding with 250 guests, and they absolutely nailed it! From the initial tasting session where we customized the menu (paneer tikka, biryani, and live chaat counter were hits), to the flawless execution on the big day, everything was top-notch. The food stayed hot and fresh throughout, portions were generous, and the staff was polite, efficient, and handled last-minute requests like extra dessert without any fuss. No complaints on hygiene or taste—our vegetarian and non-veg guests raved about it. Highly recommend for weddings or big events in Mumbai ; worth every penny!

name: TANAZ GODIWALLA A PARSI AFFAIR
description: For every Parsi, food isn’t just food. It’s a lifelong love affair. One that even goes beyond his or her regular wedding vows. Just watch a Parsi’s face light up with the mention of food and you’ll know what we mean. It’s this love affair for food that Tanaz Godiwalla, the most celebrated caterer of the Parsi community, would like to bring to the world. To open up the culinary treasures of a what is known to be a rather gated community. Which makes this menu more of a written invitation into the world of authentic Parsi food crafted by Tanaz. A legend for whom Parsis line up to book years in advance of their wedding day feasts. Her flavours are now yours.

featured_reviews.name: Derek Rahul Goveas
featured_reviews.review_text:
Brilliant lip smacking dishes to start with since the fragrance of it got me licking.
Ordered Prawn cutlet, chicken pulav, pineapple chicken, Parsi daal & custard too.
Trust me every dish in the package was yummy n delicious, although the stand out for me was the pineapple chicken. I wish I could have the recipe & make it at home that moment coz the ingredients in it got me going. Just satisfied my taste buds to another level. I'm sure these Parsi dishes wills we've you well. Definitely worth visiting and at reasonable prices too.
Good packaging and kind staff.
Overall amazing service. It's good to see how all the safety measures taken into consideration and yet very kind to serve the best food in Mumbai.
Really happy and will visit again. Thank you.

featured_reviews.name: Srijitha Roy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Looking for a Authentic Parsi Cuisine?
@aparsiaffair serves scrumptious meal made with lots of love By Tanaz Godiwalla.
.
For the first time I tried parsi food and its totally worth trying. It was a treat to my taste buds. They serve great portion of food. I tried their sunday weekend meal and It was a delight. They change their weekend menu every week. No mood to cook on weekends? A Parsi Affair is their to rescue you. I would surely love to order again and would recommend others to give it a shot.
.
What I Tried?
1) Chicken Curry with Jeera Rice - This dish was so scrumptious that I actually never tried till date. They add too many spices to get this amazing taste.
Ingredients: Cashew, Coconut, Kashmiri Chilli, groundnut, Chana Dal, Teel, Khus Khus, Turmeric Powder, Kolhapuri Chilli, Coriander Powder, Sambhar, Cumin Seeds

2) Antheli Chicken With Chips - This dish is so flavourful and they serve it with french fries. I still can't get love it's taste.
.
Taste- 5/5
Quality- 5/5
Quantity- 5/5
Cost- ₹700 for 2 person
Recommended Dish- Antheli Chicken With Chips
.
Treat yourself with these delicacies! 🤤
